title: pangrowth workflow parameters
description: Estimate pangenome growth, core size, and Hill-number diversity from a collection of genomes.

input.description: Genome archive(s) or FASTA list file(s)
input.help_text: Select one file, or use Raw input to enter several file paths separated by commas or whitespace. A wildcard pattern can also match several files (for example s3://BUCKET/pangenomes/*.txt). Commas are recommended; input paths cannot themselves contain commas or whitespace. Types are detected automatically: .txt and .list files contain one FASTA path per line; .zip, .tar.gz, and .tgz files are genome archives. Every selected file defines one pangenome. At least three genomes are required per pangenome.

outdir.help_text: Directory in which results are grouped by pangenome. Runs with multiple inputs also contain an all/ folder with combined plots.

analysis.title: Analysis Parameters
analysis.description: Parameters controlling k-mer counting and the reported analyses.

kmer.help_text: Length of nucleotide k-mers used to represent the genomes. Smaller values may be appropriate for short or heterogeneous sequences.

minimum_count.help_text: A k-mer must occur at least this many times within a genome to be considered present. Values above one can reduce sequencing-error noise in read data.

quorum.help_text: Minimum fraction of genomes in which an item must occur to count toward the core. A value of 1.0 computes the strict core; 0.9 computes a 90% soft core.

canonical.help_text: Treat each k-mer and its reverse complement as the same item. This is recommended for ordinary nucleotide genome data.

cdbg.description: Compute compacted de Bruijn graph diversity
cdbg.help_text: Also calculate the infix-equivalent histogram and use it with the k-mer histogram to estimate Hill numbers for the colored compacted de Bruijn graph. This requires an additional scan of the input.

create_plots.help_text: Generate PDF plots for the frequency histogram (absolute and five-percentage-point x-axes), expected pangenome growth, expected core size, and Hill numbers. Numerical output is always generated.

expert.title: Expert Parameters
expert.description: Low-level counting and Hill-number interpolation settings.

suffix_size.help_text: Number of suffix bits used to partition the k-mer hashtable. Larger values create more partitions and have a substantial memory overhead.

account_telomeres.help_text: Treat sequence ends as unitig-breaking telomeres. This option has an effect only when compacted de Bruijn graph diversity is enabled.

hill_points.help_text: Number of interpolation and extrapolation sample points. Use 0 to report every point.

hill_exact_tail.help_text: Maximum number of right-tail bins corrected exactly by the Bernoulli-hybrid CDBG interpolation. This option applies only when CDBG diversity is enabled and exact interpolation is disabled.

hill_adaptive_tolerance.help_text: Stop exact-tail correction after three consecutive corrections each change all Hill numbers by at most this relative tolerance. Leave unset to disable adaptive stopping.

hill_force_exact.help_text: Use the original exact interpolation rather than the faster Bernoulli-hybrid approximation. This option applies only when CDBG diversity is enabled.
